title: I think it's my old house but there's dead trees in it
content: So I had a series of weird dreams where I think I'm at a house I may have occupied as a child growing up. I say house because this place has a living room and an upstairs bedroom and has an overall homely feel except for some very weird anomalies. It looks normal and like the rental homes my family used to live in: white walls, beige carpets, old furniture that came from a garage sale, pictures of my siblings, etc. Except there's like dead trees in the ground, or leafless thin trees in a part of the living room. I go upstairs and see the same thing, though instead of a couch, there's a bed and a few wall lights and... a bunch of dead trees planted in the ground. I've also been in a similar house, but it all felt a little more cluttered, no trees except for the outside. The inside felt more 70s in a way, considering that there was wood paneling and sturdy brocade furniture and the carpeting was brown and high piled. I also remember big windows, like huge that let you see into the backyard and frontyard. The backyard would be filled with ancient trees and a garden but I wasn't allowed outside. But anyways, I wanted to share my dreams involving weird houses since I've lived in apartments for most of my life, I just find it weird I dream of houses and pretty weird nonscensical ones as well.
